title: s500-generic-45: Letter and word selective SEEG responses in the ventral occipito-temporal cortex, fast periodic visual stimulation (Lochy et al., 2018) (derivative)
description: Derivative stereo-EEG (SEEG) dataset from 37 patients with refractory epilepsy recorded at the University Hospital of Nancy during fast periodic visual stimulation. Words were presented at 2 Hz among pseudofonts, nonwords or pseudowords at 10 Hz, to measure letter- and word-selective responses in the ventral occipito-temporal cortex. The release contains the authors' Letswave-processed, 40 Hz low-pass filtered sequences repackaged in BIDS (BrainVision), with Talairach and MNI electrode coordinates.
methods_description: Intracerebral SEEG (with some scalp EEG, ECG and trigger channels) was recorded with Micromed systems during fast periodic visual stimulation: 10 Hz base stimulation of pseudofonts, nonwords or pseudowords, with a real word every fifth item (2 Hz). Authors' preprocessing in Letswave 5 included a 40 Hz Butterworth low-pass filter (order 4), cutting sequences from 2 s after onset to about 68 s, and merging sequences per condition.
